title: Cardinality Offenders & Alerts
description: SigNoz native dashboard tracking high cardinality attributes across services

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT service, attribute_key, max(unique_estimate) AS peak_cardinality FROM telemetry_health.cardinality_signal WHERE window_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY service, attribute_key ORDER BY peak_cardinality DESC LIMIT 25

clickhouse_sql.name: B
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT window_start AS time, service, attribute_key, unique_estimate FROM telemetry_health.cardinality_signal WHERE unique_estimate > 10000 AND window_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR ORDER BY time
